name: hollo
title: Hollo
description: A single-user fediverse server: your own account on Mastodon's network.
notes: Open https://{{domain}}/setup first, to create your account (the first visit is the owner's). Your handle will be @you@{{domain}}; it can't change after you federate. Hollo may restart once or twice while Postgres starts: that is normal. Postgres is backed up every day at 03:00 UTC, keeping 14.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Domain
inputs.help: Its DNS must point at this server. It becomes part of your handle.
